mapper.select: SELECT tmp.networkDeviceSum AS networkDeviceSum, tmp.networkDeviceOnLineSum AS networkDeviceOnLineSum, tmp.networkDeviceOffLineSum AS networkDeviceOffLineSum, tmp.networkDeviceUnknownLineSum AS networkDeviceUnknownLineSum, IFNULL(ROUND(tmp.networkDeviceOnLineSum * 100 / tmp.networkDeviceSum, 2), '100.00') AS networkDeviceOnLineRate FROM (SELECT COUNT(1) AS networkDeviceSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN mnd.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS networkDeviceOnLineSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN mnd.IS_ONLINE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS networkDeviceOffLineSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN mnd.IS_ONLINE IS NULL OR mnd.IS_ONLINE = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS networkDeviceUnknownLineSum FROM MONITOR_NETWORK_DEVICE mnd) tmp
